letter.body:
We have reviewed the above claim for treatment of coronary artery disease. Our review of the medical records shows that the insured person was diagnosed with hypertension in 2017, before the policy began, and this was not disclosed in the proposal form.

The claim is therefore repudiated under Clause 3.2 (Pre-existing diseases) of the policy wording, for non-disclosure of a material fact.

user: My cover first started on 2019-03-01 and has been continuous ever since, with every renewal paid on time. I didn't declare the hypertension.

The claim is repudiated under Clause 3.2 (Pre-existing diseases), as treatment of a pre-existing disease is excluded.

letter.body:
We have reviewed the above claim for cataract surgery of the left eye.

The claim is repudiated under Clause 3.3 (Specified diseases): cataract is covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage.

user: My cover started on 2024-08-01. The cataract wasn't caused by an accident.

The claim is repudiated under Clause 3.3 (Specified diseases), as hernia is subject to a waiting period.

letter.body:
We have reviewed the above claim for surgery to a fractured femur following a road traffic accident on 19/06/2025.

The claim is repudiated under Clause 3.1 (Initial waiting period), as the hospitalisation occurred within 30 days of the commencement of the policy.

We have reviewed the above claim for treatment of dengue fever, first diagnosed on 14/06/2025.

The claim is repudiated under Clause 3.1 (Initial waiting period): an illness first diagnosed within 30 days of the commencement of the policy is not covered.

user: My policy started on 2025-06-01. It wasn't an accident.

letter.body:
We have reviewed the above claim for rhinoplasty. The treating surgeon's notes record the procedure as elective, for cosmetic reasons.

The claim is repudiated under Clause 4.1 (Exclusions): cosmetic or plastic surgery is not covered.

user: The surgery was elective. There was no accident, burn or cancer.

letter.body:
We have reviewed the above claim for skin grafting and reconstructive plastic surgery to the hands.

The claim is repudiated under Clause 4.1 (Exclusions), as plastic surgery is excluded under the policy.

user: The surgery was reconstruction after burns from a kitchen fire in July 2025.

letter.body:
We have reviewed the above reimbursement claim for treatment of pneumonia.

The claim is repudiated because the claimant did not submit the discharge summary and the final hospital bill within 30 days of discharge.

We have reviewed the above claim for treatment of acute pancreatitis.

After careful consideration, we regret that the claim is not payable as per the terms and conditions of the policy.

We have reviewed the above claim for a 21-day in-patient alcohol de-addiction programme at a rehabilitation centre.

The claim is repudiated under Clause 4.2 (Exclusions): treatment for alcoholism, drug or substance abuse is not covered.

We have reviewed the above claim for umbilical hernia repair.

The policy renewal due on 01/04/2023 was paid on 25/04/2023, after the due date, which is a break in the policy. The waiting period for specified diseases therefore restarted from 25/04/2023, and the claim is repudiated under Clause 3.3 (Specified diseases).

user: My cover started on 2021-04-01. The 2023 renewal was due on 2023-04-01 and I paid it on 2023-04-25. It wasn't an accident.
